# Plusock

> > Plusock specializes in plus-size compression socks, diabetic footwear, and compression wear designed for comfort, circulation support, and medical relief.

Plusock is an e-commerce platform offering extended-size compression socks (2XL-7XL) and related compression wear for varicose veins, edema, diabetes, and athletic recovery. The site features bulk discount bundles, seasonal collections, and complementary footwear products including slippers and diabetic shoes.

## Key Topics

- Plus-size compression socks (2XL-7XL)
- Graduated compression (20-30 mmHg)
- Diabetic socks and slippers
- Wide calf support
- Compression sleeves (knee-high, thigh-high, ankle)
- Varicose vein relief
- Athletic compression wear
- Bundle deals and bulk discounts
- Slipper socks with grippers
- Velcro diabetic footwear
- Seasonal collections
- Medical-grade compression
- Swelling and edema support
- Plus-size underwear sets
- Recovery and circulation

## Core Collections

- [All Products](https://www.plusock.com/collections/all): Complete product collection showcasing all Plusock compression socks and plus-size sock styles.
- [Plus Size Compression Socks | Wide Calf](https://www.plusock.com/collections/obese-compression-socks): Plus-size compression socks (2XL-7XL) for swollen feet, varicose veins, and wide calf support.
- [Compression Socks For Women | 20-30 mmHg](https://plusock.com/collections/compression-socks): Women's compression socks with 20-30 mmHg graduated compression for diabetes and circulation.
- [Ankle Compression Socks](https://www.plusock.com/collections/ankle-compression-socks): Ankle compression socks for swollen ankles with arch support and cushioning for daily wear.

## Compression Wear by Length

- [Knee High](https://www.plusock.com/collections/knee-high): Knee-high compression sleeves and footless calf compression socks in cooling and medical styles.
- [Thigh High](https://www.plusock.com/collections/thigh-high): Thigh-high compression sleeves and toeless compression socks with breathable modal fabrics.
- [Quarter Sleeves](https://www.plusock.com/collections/quarter-sleeves): Calf compression sleeves and quarter-length athletic compression wear for sports and daily use.
- [Thigh](https://www.plusock.com/collections/thigh): Thigh compression sleeves and hip support belts for plus-size joint protection and compression.
- [Knee Braces](https://www.plusock.com/collections/knee-braces): Knee braces, pads, and sleeves collection offering joint protection and compression support.
